subject.title: [Feature]: Merge iOS Privacy and Location card state

question: Should Settings > Privacy replace the current Location segmented control with a Location Sharing switch plus Access Level row, or only remove the duplicate Location-derived Privacy card for now?
rationale: The duplicate card is source-reproducible, but the requested control redesign changes native app UX and should be sponsored or reviewed by the iOS settings owner before automation rewrites it.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow full redesign
options.body: Remove the duplicate Privacy card and implement the Location Sharing plus Access Level UI with focused Settings and location-mode tests.

options.title: Start with duplicate-card removal
options.body: Keep the existing segmented Location control for now and only remove the redundant Location-derived Privacy status card.

options.title: Defer the UX redesign
options.body: Leave current main unchanged until a maintainer accepts a broader iOS Privacy settings direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow full redesign
recommendation.body: Remove the duplicate Privacy card and implement the Location Sharing plus Access Level UI with focused Settings and location-mode tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent blame and merged PR history make this the strongest available owner signal for the iOS Settings > Privacy surface.
